nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How do Islam and Cullen (2021) define internal and external traceability in the context of the food industry?
nodes.answer: Islam and Cullen (2021) distinguish between internal traceability, which is used within a single company, and external traceability, which involves tracing across multiple links or companies in the supply chain.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: Why is granularity considered important for traceability in a farmed salmon supply chain according to Karen, Donnelly, and Olsen (2011)?
nodes.answer: Granularity is considered important for traceability in a farmed salmon supply chain because it enables the tracking of individual fish, ensuring accurate information on origin, handling, and quality.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How do diagnostic models contribute to assessing traceability system performance in fish processing plants as discussed by Gonna et al. (2013)?
nodes.answer: Gonna et al. (2013) present a diagnostic model that helps in evaluating traceability system performance in fish processing plants, thereby aiding in enhancing traceability processes and efficiency.
